notes.title: ☄️ Battle Royale Event ☄️
notes.content:
Greetings dear players,

Are you ready to fight Doh and accept a [b]new challenge[/b] ?

[h1]☄️ Battle Royale Event  ☄️[/h1]

☄️ We invite you to play Arkanoid - Eternal Battle : Battle Royale F2P Edition to take part in the [b]Battle Royale Event[/b]. On [b]June 13th[/b] (5pm CEST, 11am ET, midnight JST), we will be live for [b]1 hour on Steam[/b], playing the [b]Eternal Battle Mode[/b] with the community.

🎮 How to participate? At precisely 5pm CEST, you will need to [b]launch the game[/b] and select the Eternal Battle Mode. Keep the [b]stream in the background[/b] to be sure when to enter the room. Any player who manages to [b]reach the same room as the admin[/b] will be considered a participant in the challenge. 

🏆 Each time you are [b]first[/b] (except AI) [b]AND above the admin[/b] during a game, you get a reward at the end of the event. People who have already won [b]can still take part[/b], but will no longer receive a reward.

📬 Stay connected!
